Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Receiver. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
WakeUp: Signal bounce. Contact beside the cab.
Chasing: I have their movement on the relay!
Waiting: Dead air ahead. Checking the next carriage.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Receiver - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Enforcer. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: Z-52 enforcement. End of the road.
Chasing: You are staying inside our perimeter!
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Enforcer - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Breacher. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: Stand clear of the entry team.
Waiting: Check the latch. Then check the charge.
FriendDied: Breach partner down! Cover the opening!
Wounded: Door plates held. Shoulder did not.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Breacher - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Deadwire. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: No transmission. You already heard too much.
Chasing: I do not need a radio to follow you.
Waiting: The engine covers the sound of a blade.
FriendDied: Our quietest channel just went silent.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Deadwire - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Surveyor. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: Range markers set along the chase route.
Waiting: Wind correction ready. Waiting for the turn.
FriendDied: Our spotter is off the scope!
Wounded: Optic is clean. Face is not.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Surveyor - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Suppressor. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: Suppression belt ready. Stay behind my arc.
Attacking: Heads down until the barrel cools!
Chasing: I can rake the whole escape route!
Waiting: Feeding another belt. Keep the lane watched.
FriendDied: Cover gun lost! Tighten the formation!
Wounded: Plate strike. The belt is still feeding.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Suppressor - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Spark. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: Spark brought a little electrical interference.
WakeUp: Somebody is crouched near the fuel line.
Chasing: Your hiding spot has excellent conductivity.
Waiting: Counting the fuse. Do not bump my elbow.
FriendDied: They cut off our light show!
Wounded: That was not my capacitor popping!
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Spark - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Warden. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: The cab stays sealed under my watch.
WakeUp: Unauthorized hand on the access rail.
Chasing: The protected route ends at me!
Waiting: Inspecting armor seals. Nobody slips past.
FriendDied: Inner guard breached! Lock the next hatch!
Wounded: Outer shell cracked. Inner guard stands.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Warden - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Marshal. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
WakeUp: Pattern change. They are switching sides.
Attacking: Enforcers forward. Surveyor, take the gap.
Chasing: Cut their route at the next junction.
Waiting: Report positions. Nobody improvises a pursuit.
FriendDied: Replace the fallen sector. Do not leave it open.
Wounded: Command is hit. Continue the pattern.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Marshal - custom chatter

Chatter.Description: Original event dialogue written for Z-52 Director Blackout. Font refers only to an installed MPN typeface.
Spawned: All chase channels answer to Blackout now.
WakeUp: Engines heard. Light up the crossing.
Chasing: Every exit gets the same treatment!
Waiting: Last belt counted. I intend to use it.
FriendDied: Whole section went dark. Fill their arc!
EnemyDown: Another patch of silence behind us.
Chatter.Name: Z-52 Director Blackout - custom chatter

Character.Name: Z-52 Receiver
Character.Description: The first carrier of a dead frequency. Receivers race ahead of Z-52 formations and attack from the edges. Dark fatigues, pale light armor and a cyan goggle strip identify the scouts.
Character.Title: Signal Scout

Character.Name: Z-52 Enforcer
Character.Description: Z-52 treats an occupied room as a containment breach. Enforcers advance behind porcelain-colored carriers, using disciplined carbine fire to pin down anything still transmitting.
Character.Title: Containment Rifleman

Character.Name: Z-52 Breacher
Character.Description: White riot plating and a sealed black face distinguish the breach teams. Their pump shotguns punish close approaches, but their heavy equipment gives opponents room to reposition.
Character.Title: Door Suppression

Character.Name: Z-52 Deadwire
Character.Description: A cyan visor beneath a dark hood is the last warning before a Deadwire reaches striking distance. These visible, lightly armored sword specialists trade staying power for evasive movement. No camouflage augmentation is used.
Character.Title: Silent Interdictor

Character.Name: Z-52 Surveyor
Character.Description: Surveyors mark their perimeter with the sound of a heavy rifle. A long charcoal hood breaks up the helmet silhouette; thin pale armor keeps them mobile while they seek distant firing positions.
Character.Title: Range Acquisition

Character.Name: Z-52 Suppressor
Character.Description: Suppressors erase lanes of movement with sustained machine-gun fire. Their broad white armor and heavy respirator are impossible to mistake for a Receiver. Slow movement and a large silhouette are the price of that pressure.
Character.Title: Channel Denial

Character.Name: Z-52 Spark
Character.Description: Orange optics identify the technicians who prepare a room for containment. Sparks combine compact automatic weapons with flashbangs, disrupting targets before the Enforcers advance.
Character.Title: Disruption Technician

Character.Name: Z-52 Warden
Character.Description: Wardens stand where the signal ends. Heavy pale riot armor surrounds a towering hammer carrier trained to defend choke points. They cannot chase a scout, but careless melee approaches meet a different kind of shutdown.
Character.Title: Perimeter Custodian

Character.Name: Z-52 Marshal
Character.Description: A long dark coat and orange rank beret separate a Marshal from the containment line. Field supervisors carry heavy rifles and enough experience to punish opponents who ignore them for the nearest target.
Character.Title: Field Supervisor

Character.Name: Z-52 Director Blackout
Character.Description: Director Blackout closes operations personally. A pale armored coat, orange command beret and dark faceplate identify Z-52s final authority. Three mortal corpus blocks make this a sustained encounter, not an invincible one.
Character.Title: Last Transmission
